item.title: Weil, Gotshal & Manges eyes merger options after rainmakers exit, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: Law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges is considering options for its future, including a potential merger with a competitor, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people with knowledge of the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges is considering options for its future, including a potential merger with a competitor, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people with knowledge of the matter. The company has been canvassing its partners and exploring ways to strengthen its business through strategic hires and promotions, and it could still remain independent, the report said. Weil, Gotshal & Manges did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Reuters could not immediately verify the report. This follows a [USN:L6N4530WP TEXT:"string"] of departures at Weil, including prominent New York dealmaker Michael Aiello and five other M&A partners who are set to join Cravath, Swaine & Moore, along with [USN:L6N4590YZ TEXT:"two"] London-based M&A partners who recently moved to Sullivan & Cromwell. Top leaders at the US law firm have become more open to the idea of combining with a competitor, and some have held informal discussions to gauge interest in a deal, the Bloomberg News report said. Founded in 1931, Weil, Gotshal & Manges is a New York-based law firm known for its M&A, restructuring and bankruptcy practice, with about 1,200 lawyers worldwide.

item.title: Report: Falcons to start QB Cooper Rush vs. Panthers
item.description: Atlanta Falcons quarterback Cooper Rush took the first-team reps at practice on Friday and is expected to make his second straight start on Sunday, NFL Network reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Atlanta Falcons quarterback Cooper Rush took the first-team reps at practice on Friday and is expected to make his second straight start on Sunday, NFL Network reported. Atlanta (0-1) hosts NFC South rival Carolina Panthers (0-1) in its home opener on Sunday. Rush, 32, split the first-team reps earlier this week with Michael Penix Jr., who is not quite ready to return from an ACL injury suffered last season. Tua Tagovailoa, initially slated to be the Week 1 starter, is recovering from an oblique injury sustained just days before the Falcons kicked off the season at Pittsburgh. Making his Falcons debut last Sunday, Rush completed 12 of 22 passes for 143 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the 20-13 loss to the Steelers. Eight of Rush's completions were to running back Bijan Robinson, and Pittsburgh star T.J. Watt returned one of his interceptions 35 yards for a touchdown in the fourth quarter. --Field Level Media

item.title: Automotrices instan a Trump a mantener fuera a fabricantes de autos chinos antes de reunión con Xi
item.description: Grandes automotrices, proveedores y concesionarios instaron el viernes al presidente Donald Trump a mantener a los fabricantes de automóviles chinos fuera del mercado estadounidense, de cara a su reunión con el presidente de China, Xi Jinping, la próxima semana.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: Grandes automotrices, proveedores y concesionarios instaron el viernes al presidente Donald Trump a mantener a los fabricantes de automóviles chinos fuera del mercado estadounidense, de cara a su reunión con el presidente de China, Xi Jinping, la próxima semana. La semana pasada, Trump dijo a Fox News que no le importaría que las automotrices chinas fabriquen vehículos en Estados Unidos. "Instamos a su administración a mantener políticas que mantengan la puerta firmemente cerrada a los fabricantes de automóviles chinos que pretendan vender, importar o fabricar vehículos en Estados Unidos", reza una carta dirigida a Trump por seis grupos que representan a General Motors (GM.N) , Toyota (7203.T) , Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) , Ford (F.N) , Hyundai (005380.KS) , Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , Tesla (TSLA.O) y otros. Ni la Casa Blanca ni la embajada china en Washington hicieron comentarios de inmediato. "Las automotrices chinas no tienen cuota de mercado en Estados Unidos. Permitirles abrir una planta en el país les proporcionaría un punto de apoyo en el mercado a costa de los fabricantes que operan aquí", dice la carta firmada por la Alianza para la Innovación Automotriz, el Consejo Americano de Política Automotriz, Autos Drive America, MEMA —la Asociación de Proveedores de Vehículos—, la Asociación Nacional de Concesionarios de Automóviles y la Asociación de Transporte de Emisión Cero. Estas organizaciones sostienen que la inversión china en Estados Unidos no crearía nuevos puestos de trabajo estadounidenses, sino que "desviaría puestos de trabajo de los fabricantes que han realizado inversiones generacionales en Estados Unidos hacia empresas que son propiedad del Gobierno chino y están gestionadas por este". La senadora demócrata por Míchigan, Elissa Slotkin, citó un informe según el cual Xi podría traer al fabricante de automóviles chino BYD a Washington para las reuniones, y dijo que, si eso ocurre, "solo podemos suponer que hay acuerdos en marcha para permitir la importación de vehículos chinos, o que se está invitando a empresas chinas a establecerse en Estados Unidos". Una normativa impuesta por la administración del expresidente Joe Biden a principios de 2025 prohibió de hecho a todas las automotrices chinas vender o fabricar vehículos de pasajeros en Estados Unidos, alegando que podrían enviar datos sensibles de los conductores a China. Washington también mantiene aranceles superiores al 100% sobre los vehículos eléctricos chinos. El Congreso está estudiando actualmente una legislación que endurecería la prohibición de los vehículos chinos. El Bluetooth, el Wi-Fi, la conectividad móvil y algunas tecnologías de comunicaciones por satélite están sujetas a estas normas, motivadas por preocupaciones de seguridad nacional relacionadas con la capacidad de los vehículos para recopilar datos confidenciales sobre los propietarios estadounidenses.

item.title: Dillard's to shift primary listings to Texas as new stock exchange gains traction
item.description: Dillard's on Friday said it would transfer its primary listings from the NYSE to the Texas Stock Exchange, joining a string of companies heading to the fledgling bourse that aims to challenge the two dominant US national stock exchanges.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dillard's (DDS.N) on Friday said it would transfer its primary listings from the NYSE to the Texas Stock Exchange, joining a string of companies heading to the fledgling bourse that aims to challenge the two dominant US national stock exchanges. Texas has long pitched itself as a lightly regulated, corporate-friendly alternative to the US coastal states, and TXSE's backers say the new exchange will mirror that environment, countering the trend of "more regulation, more taxation" in New York and other established financial hubs. Besides the fashion retailer, regional lenders Origin Bancorp (OBK.N) and Texas Capital Bancshares (TCBI.O) announced earlier this month that they would shift their listings to the TXSE from the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq, respectively. All three companies are slated to begin trading on the new exchange in October. While the TXSE is pitching Texas' business-friendly laws and regulations to attract listings, companies on the new exchange must also be incorporated in Texas to benefit from the state's legal and regulatory protections. Several major corporations have already relocated their headquarters to Texas, some citing a 2025 state law that bolsters corporate defenses against shareholder lawsuits, including Exxon Mobil (XOM.N) and Elon Musk's Tesla (TSLA.O) and SpaceX (SPCX.O) . None of these, however, have shifted their primary stock listings to the TXSE. The new exchange is backed by Wall Street investors including BlackRock (BLK.N) , Citadel Securities and Charles Schwab (SCHW.N) . Kelcy Warren, a Texas-based billionaire and executive chairman of pipeline operator Energy Transfer (ET.N) , also had a significant stake in TXSE Group as of 2025, according to an SEC filing. Earlier this month, the pipeline operator joined midstream energy services provider USA Compression Partners (USAC.N) and fuel distribution firms Sunoco LP (SUN.N) and SunocoCorp LLC (SUNC.N) in announcing a shift in primary listings to the TXSE by early October. All four companies are headquartered in Texas.

item.title: Schmid diz que defendeu alta de juros pelo Fed e que inflação não é impulsionada apenas por energia
item.description: O presidente do Federal Reserve de Kansas City, Jeff Schmid, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que defendeu a decisão do banco central nesta semana de aumentar a taxa de juros como um passo para reduzir a inflação, que vem se mantendo acima da meta de 2% do Fed e não é impulsionada apenas pelos altos custos da energia.
item.dc:creator: Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: O presidente do Federal Reserve de Kansas City, Jeff Schmid, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que defendeu a decisão do banco central nesta semana de aumentar a taxa de juros como um passo para reduzir a inflação, que vem se mantendo acima da meta de 2% do Fed e não é impulsionada apenas pelos altos custos da energia. “Nosso problema com a inflação não se resume apenas à energia”, disse Schmid em discurso preparado para um grupo bancário do Colorado. “A inflação excluindo a energia também tem se mantido elevada, e uma ampla gama de bens e serviços está apresentando aumento de preços incompatível com nossa meta de estabilidade de preços.” Schmid disse que a inflação parece estar caminhando para ficar acima de 3%. Schmid, que não é votante nas decisões sobre a taxa de juros este ano, não indicou se acredita que novos aumentos serão necessários para levar a inflação de volta à meta do Fed. (Reportagem de Howard Schneider)

item.title: Chess-FIDE candidate Rosenstein targets Carlsen return and governance reform
item.description: International Chess Federation (FIDE) presidential candidate Wadim Rosenstein said he would seek to bring Magnus Carlsen back into the classical world championship cycle if elected, while promising governance reforms, greater transparency and tougher conflict-of-interest rules.
item.dc:creator: Karan Prashant Saxena
item.content:encoded: International Chess Federation (FIDE) presidential candidate Wadim Rosenstein said he would seek to bring Magnus Carlsen back into the classical world championship cycle if elected, while promising governance reforms, greater transparency and tougher conflict-of-interest rules. The September 26 vote will determine the direction of a federation grappling with governance questions, Russia's role in the sport and a debate over how to balance the game's classical traditions with its fast-growing commercial appeal. Rosenstein said the classical world championship should remain the sport's premier title despite the growing popularity of freestyle, rapid, blitz and online formats. The election will be held during FIDE's General Assembly in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, with Rosenstein facing German entrepreneur Jan Henric Buettner and Kazakh businessman Timur Turlov. The race took shape after longtime FIDE president Arkady Dvorkovich stepped aside following his inclusion on the European Union's latest sanctions list. "Among all the presidential candidates, I think I have the best relations with Magnus Carlsen and Hikaru Nakamura," Rosenstein, a German entrepreneur and chess promoter, told Reuters in an interview. Norway's Carlsen, a five-times world champion, is the world's top-ranked classical player, while American Nakamura is ranked second. "I would love to bring them back into classical competition and I hope I will succeed." Carlsen announced in 2022 that he would not defend his world title in 2023 and has not returned to the world championship cycle, increasingly focusing on other formats while continuing to play selected classical events. His decision helped fuel a wider debate over how chess should balance its traditional format with changing commercial interests and audience habits. Rosenstein said the classical crown should remain at the centre of the sport. "We need to communicate to the world that the most important title is the classical world championship," he said. "We need to respect our traditions." He said any review of the championship structure would require consultation with sponsors and national federations to ensure commercial considerations did not diminish the prestige of the title. RUSSIA, BELARUS AND NEUTRALITY Rosenstein said FIDE should continue to follow Court of Arbitration for Sport rulings concerning Russia and Belarus. FIDE temporarily suspended the Russian Chess Federation in June after saying it had failed to comply within the prescribed deadline with a CAS ruling concerning the federation's incorporation of organisations from occupied Ukrainian territories. "We have a CAS decision we need to follow. There is no way around it," Rosenstein said. The status of Russian and Belarusian competitors has remained contentious across international sport since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, with governing bodies balancing legal rulings, neutrality policies and political pressure. Rosenstein said chess should remain a force for unity while operating within existing legal frameworks. "Sport must be there to connect people, to bring peace into the world," he said. Rosenstein, founder of WR Chess and chairman of WR Group Holding, has faced questions during the campaign over potential conflicts of interest and his business links to Russia. WR Chess organises elite tournaments featuring some of the world’s leading grandmasters. Rosenstein’s WR Group previously carried out logistics, certification and other projects in Russia, including work in the oil and gas sector, but he has said those projects were dropped after sanctions were imposed following Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine. He rejected suggestions that private interests could influence FIDE decision-making under his leadership and said conflict-of-interest safeguards would be strengthened. Under his proposed model, FIDE employees would not be permitted to work simultaneously for private chess organisations. "If you are a FIDE employee, you need to work on FIDE only," he said. "There will be no conflict of interest at all." Rosenstein said a central part of his programme would be to professionalise FIDE's internal operations and improve its commercial performance. "Billions of people know what chess is, but we have only a few sponsors inside chess," he said.

item.title: Liverpool's Jacquet among new faces in Zidane's first France squad
item.description: New France coach Zinedine Zidane unveiled his highly anticipated first squad on Friday for the upcoming Nations League fixtures, naming several new faces, including Liverpool centre back Jeremy Jacquet, who has impressed in his debut season at Anfield.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New France coach [USN:L6N43U0Q7 TEXT:"Zinedine Zidane"] unveiled his highly anticipated first squad on Friday for the upcoming Nations League fixtures, naming several new faces, including Liverpool centre back Jeremy Jacquet, who has impressed in his debut season at Anfield. The 54-year-old Zidane, whose brilliance helped France to win their first World Cup on home soil in 1998, returns to the national team tasked with turning recent near-misses into trophies. Zidane enjoyed a glittering managerial career at former club Real Madrid, leading the Spanish side to three successive Champions League titles. Similar success will be expected with France, who boast some of football's most gifted players, as they build up to the 2028 European Championship and the 2030 World Cup. France won the 2018 World Cup, finished runners-up to Argentina in 2022 and reached the [USN:L6N43G1EI TEXT:"semi-finals of this year's showpiece tournament"]. "I've always followed the French national team. I have a huge attachment to this team," Zidane told a news conference. "I'm fully aware of the task I've been given. I'm here to coach this team. There's no break with the past. It's a continuation of my ideas." Goalkeeper Guillaume Restes, defenders Jacquet and Andy Diouf, midfielder Lucas Da Cunha and forward Esteban Lepaul were among the players given their first senior call-ups by Zidane. Madrid midfielder Aurelien Tchouameni, who is being eased back after returning from injury, and Inter Milan forward Marcus Thuram were among the notable absentees in the 23-player squad. Zidane confirmed that Madrid forward Kylian Mbappe, France's all-time leading scorer with 66 international goals, will remain captain of the national team. [USN:L8N43U0SY TEXT:"Zidane was appointed as France coach"] until the 2030 World Cup in July, succeeding Didier Deschamps and becoming the third member of France's 1998 World Cup-winning team to lead Les Bleus. He will take charge for the first time in the Nations League group stage against Turkey in Izmit on September 25. France then travel to Belgium before hosting Italy and Belgium in October.

item.title: Indústria automobilística pressiona Trump para manter montadoras chinesas fora do país antes do encontro com Xi
item.description: As principais montadoras, fornecedores e concessionárias dos Estados Unidos pediram na sexta-feira ao presidente Donald Trump que mantenha as montadoras chinesas fora do mercado norte-americano, antes de seu encontro com o presidente chinês Xi Jinping na próxima semana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As principais montadoras, fornecedores e concessionárias dos Estados Unidos pediram na sexta-feira ao presidente Donald Trump que mantenha as montadoras chinesas fora do mercado norte-americano, antes de seu encontro com o presidente chinês Xi Jinping na próxima semana. Na semana passada, Trump disse à Fox News que não teria problemas em permitir que montadoras chinesas fabricassem carros nos Estados Unidos. "Instamos sua administração a manter políticas que impeçam veementemente as montadoras chinesas de vender, importar ou fabricar veículos nos EUA", dizia uma carta enviada a Trump por seis grupos que representam a General Motors (GM.N) , Toyota (7203.T) , Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) , Ford (F.N) , Hyundai (005380.KS) , Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , Tesla (TSLA.O) e outros. A Casa Branca e a embaixada chinesa em Washington não se pronunciaram de imediato. "As montadoras chinesas não têm participação de mercado nos EUA. Permitir que elas abram uma fábrica no país lhes daria uma posição no mercado norte-americano às custas das montadoras que operam aqui", dizia a carta assinada pela Alliance for Automotive Innovation, American Automotive Policy Council, Autos Drive America, MEMA -- The Vehicle Suppliers Association, National Automobile Dealers Association e Zero Emission Transportation Association. Os grupos argumentam que o investimento chinês nos EUA não criaria novos empregos norte-americanos, mas "desviaria empregos de fabricantes que fizeram investimentos de longa data nos EUA para empresas pertencentes e operadas pelo governo chinês". A senadora democrata de Michigan, Elissa Slotkin, citou uma reportagem que afirma que Xi Jinping pode levar a montadora chinesa BYD a Washington para as reuniões, dizendo que, se isso acontecer, "só podemos presumir que existem acordos em andamento para permitir a importação de carros chineses, ou que empresas chinesas estão sendo convidadas a se instalarem nos EUA". Uma regulamentação imposta pelo governo do ex-presidente Joe Biden no início de 2025 proibiu efetivamente todas as montadoras chinesas de vender ou fabricar veículos de passageiros nos EUA, sob a alegação de que poderiam enviar dados sensíveis dos motoristas para a China. Washington também mantém tarifas superiores a 100% sobre veículos elétricos chineses. O Congresso está atualmente analisando uma legislação que endureceria a proibição de veículos chineses. Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, conectividade celular e algumas tecnologias de comunicação via satélite estão abrangidas pelas regras com base em preocupações de segurança nacional relacionadas à capacidade dos veículos de coletar dados sensíveis sobre proprietários norte-americanos. (Por David Shepardson)

item.title: SpaceX to fly more NASA crews to space station under expanded $5.92 billion deal
item.description: NASA said Friday that the agency had given SpaceX a $946 million contract to fly three more astronaut missions to the International Space Station, extending the company's crewed flights to the station through 2030.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: NASA said Friday that the agency had given SpaceX (SPCX.O) a $946 million contract to fly three more astronaut missions to the International Space Station, extending the company's crewed flights to the station through 2030. The deal brings SpaceX's total number of NASA astronaut flights under the contract to 17 and raises the contract's total value to $5.92 billion. NASA is relying heavily on SpaceX to keep astronauts traveling to and from the station while it works to maintain a second U.S. option through Boeing (BA.N) . The contract covers preparing astronauts and spacecraft on the ground, launching them, operating the mission in space, bringing crews home and recovering the capsule. It also includes carrying supplies and keeping the spacecraft at the station as an emergency escape vehicle. The agency chose SpaceX and Boeing in 2014 to develop spacecraft capable of carrying astronauts to the space station. The goal was to give the United States a regular domestic launch capability after NASA retired the space shuttle, ending years of reliance on Russia's Soyuz spacecraft. Boeing's Starliner suffered problems on its 2024 crewed test flight, prompting NASA to return the capsule empty and bring astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams home on a SpaceX Dragon after a planned 10-day mission became a more than nine-month ISS stay. NASA approved SpaceX's system for astronaut flights in November 2020. Since then, SpaceX has become the agency's main provider for rotating crews at the station, using its Crew Dragon capsule and Falcon 9 rocket to carry up to four astronauts, as well as supplies. NASA wants both SpaceX and Boeing operating crew flights so that an accident or technical problem affecting one company does not halt US astronaut access to the station.

item.title: Sismo de mediana intensidad sacude capital chilena

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un sismo de magnitud 5 sacudió el viernes la capital chilena, dijo el Centro Sismológico Euromediterráneo (EMSC). El Centro Sismológico Nacional de la Universidad de Chile, por su parte, reportó que el temblor tuvo una magnitud de 4,7 grados a una profundidad de 97,62 kilómetros en el torno de Farellones, en la cordillera de Los Andes, cerca de Santiago. No se reportaban víctimas ni daños, dijo el servicio de emergencias Senapred. Chile es un país de alta actividad sísmica.

item.title: Reporte de ONU encuentra violencia sexual generalizada en guerra de Ucrania
item.description: Las fuerzas rusas cometieron actos generalizados de violencia sexual contra civiles y prisioneros de guerra en Ucrania, incluidas violaciones en grupo y descargas eléctricas en los genitales, mientras que las autoridades ucranianas también fueron responsables de un número menor de violaciones.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Le Poidevin
item.content:encoded: Las fuerzas rusas cometieron actos generalizados de violencia sexual contra civiles y prisioneros de guerra en Ucrania, incluidas violaciones en grupo y descargas eléctricas en los genitales, mientras que las autoridades ucranianas también fueron responsables de un número menor de violaciones. En un informe publicado el viernes, la Oficina de Derechos Humanos de la ONU dijo que documentó 1.004 casos verificados de violencia sexual relacionada con el conflicto entre febrero de 2022, cuando Rusia lanzó su invasión a gran escala de Ucrania, y julio de 2026. De esos casos, el 89% se atribuyó a la parte rusa, incluidos miembros de las fuerzas armadas, del servicio penitenciario y de los organismos de seguridad, mientras que el 11% se relacionó con Ucrania, incluidos miembros de las fuerzas armadas ucranianas. La misión diplomática permanente de Rusia en Ginebra no quiso hacer comentarios sobre el informe. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Ucrania declaró en un comunicado que acogía con satisfacción la publicación del informe que, dijo, ponía de manifiesto la magnitud de las violaciones de los derechos humanos perpetradas por Rusia y las medidas que está adoptando Ucrania para prevenir dicha violencia e indemnizar a las víctimas. El comunicado no se pronunció directamente sobre las conclusiones relativas a los incidentes de abusos cometidos por las fuerzas ucranianas. El informe advertía que las conclusiones no eran exhaustivas, ya que la violencia sexual relacionada con el conflicto sigue en buena medida sin denunciarse . Señalaba que la negativa de Rusia a conceder a la Oficina del Alto Comisionado de las Naciones Unidas para los Derechos Humanos acceso al territorio ucraniano ocupado, a los prisioneros de guerra y a los detenidos civiles significaba que las cifras probablemente subestimaban la verdadera magnitud de las violaciones. En las zonas ocupadas de Ucrania y en el interior de Rusia, las autoridades rusas cometieron actos de violencia sexual contra prisioneros de guerra ucranianos y civiles detenidos en todas las fases de su cautiverio, incluyendo durante la captura, el traslado, los interrogatorios y la detención, según el informe. Las denuncias incluyeron violaciones en grupo, violaciones, mutilación genital y el uso de descargas eléctricas en los genitales de los hombres con un teléfono de campaña de la era soviética conocido como "tapik". Las conclusiones se basaron en entrevistas con víctimas de violencia sexual cometida por ambas partes. La mayoría de las víctimas detenidas eran hombres, en particular prisioneros de guerra y detenidos, aunque también se vieron afectadas mujeres y niños, principalmente en las zonas de Ucrania ocupadas por Rusia. "A menudo se cree erróneamente que la violencia sexual en los conflictos afecta principalmente a mujeres y niñas, cuando en el contexto de la guerra de Ucrania la mayoría de los supervivientes son hombres", dijo Danielle Bell, jefa de la Misión de Observación de los Derechos Humanos de las Naciones Unidas en Ucrania. "Además, los hombres y las mujeres necesitan soluciones y enfoques diferentes para su recuperación", añadió. El informe concluyó que Rusia no había tomado medidas para prevenir, investigar o enjuiciar la violencia sexual cometida por su personal y que no había respondido a las solicitudes de información de la OACDH. PRISIONEROS DE GUERRA RUSOS En el territorio controlado por el Gobierno ucraniano, casi la mitad de las violaciones atribuidas a las autoridades ucranianas contra prisioneros de guerra y detenidos rusos y de terceros países consistieron en amenazas de violencia sexual y golpes en los genitales. El ACNUDH señaló que no había documentado ningún caso de violación de prisioneros de guerra rusos por parte de las fuerzas ucranianas. El ACNUDH señaló que los prisioneros de guerra rusos y de terceros países denunciaron actos de violencia sexual en 10 centros de detención oficiales y en 55 lugares no oficiales o de tránsito. El Gobierno ucraniano había tomado algunas medidas para prevenir tales violaciones y había cooperado con las solicitudes de la OACDH, aunque los esfuerzos para garantizar la rendición de cuentas seguían siendo limitados, añadió. "Me alarma profundamente la prevalencia de estos actos abominables documentados en nuestro informe, y temo que, con toda probabilidad, sigan ocurriendo en medio de la violencia incesante que presenciamos cada día en Ucrania", declaró el Alto Comisionado de Naciones Unidas para los Derechos Humanos, Volker Turk.

item.title: Japón realiza verificaciones de las tasas de cambio en el mercado de divisas: Nikkei
item.description: Las autoridades japonesas llevaron a cabo comprobaciones de las tasas de cambio en el mercado de divisas, informó el periódico Nikkei, lo que provocó un fuerte repunte del yen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las autoridades japonesas llevaron a cabo comprobaciones de las tasas de cambio en el mercado de divisas, informó el periódico Nikkei, lo que provocó un fuerte repunte del yen. La noticia se produjo tras la caída de la moneda, a pesar de la decisión del Banco de Japón del viernes de subir las tasas de interés hasta el 1,25%, su nivel más alto en 31 años. El Ministerio de Finanzas de Japón, que dirige la intervención, no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.

item.content:encoded: O índice europeu STOXX 600 caiu nesta sexta-feira, em meio a perdas generalizadas lideradas pelas ações dos setores automotivo e de telecomunicações, registrando também queda semanal em um período marcado pelo recuo nos preços do petróleo e pelas decisões sobre taxas de juros de grandes bancos centrais. O índice pan-europeu (.STOXX) caiu 1,1%, para 635,45 pontos, devolvendo quase todos os ganhos obtidos nas duas últimas sessões. No acumulado da semana, registrou queda de 0,6%. O setor automotivo e de peças (.SXAP) teve queda de 3,4%, com a Volkswagen liderando as perdas em sua maior queda em um único dia desde setembro de 2025, de 5,6%. A empresa reduziu drasticamente suas projeções, apontando 10 bilhões de euros em itens não recorrentes relacionados à sua participação na fabricante de carros esportivos de luxo Porsche (P911_p.DE) , provisões para cortes de pessoal e um mercado chinês fraco. As ações da Porsche caíram 4,9%. As ações do setor de telecomunicações (.SXKP) caíram 3,3%, registrando a maior queda em um único dia desde abril de 2025, com a Airtel Africa (AAF.L) recuando 11,3% e se tornando a ação com maior queda no STOXX depois que a Bloomberg News noticiou que sua unidade Airtel Money está considerando reduzir a escala de seu IPO em Londres. O setor de alimentos e bebidas (.SX3P) registrou queda de 1,9%, com a Nestlé (NESN.S) caindo 2,6% após a Rússia ter assumido o controle dos ativos locais da gigante suíça do setor. Os preços do petróleo reduziram as perdas anteriores nesta sexta-feira, à medida que os mercados avaliavam a oferta saudita em meio a preocupações com a ampliação do conflito no Oriente Médio. Ainda assim, as ações do setor de energia (.SXEP) caíram 0,7% e registraram queda de 0,5% na semana. Uma trégua na liquidação no mercado de títulos, juntamente com a queda nos preços do petróleo bruto, ajudou a melhorar o apetite por risco nesta semana. Esses movimentos ocorreram mesmo com o aumento dos juros pelo Federal Reserve, enquanto o Banco da Inglaterra manteve sua taxa e alertou que um aperto monetário adicional pode ser necessário caso a guerra no Irã se prolongue. Em LONDRES, o índice Financial Times (.FTSE) recuou 1,45%, a 10.659,13 pontos. Em FRANKFURT, o índice DAX (.GDAXI) caiu 1,60%, a 25.304,06 pontos. Em PARIS, o índice CAC-40 (.FCHI) perdeu 1,49%, a 8.065,02 pontos. Em MILÃO, o índice Ftse/Mib (.FTMIB) teve desvalorização de 1,60%, a 51.545,25 pontos. Em MADRI, o índice Ibex-35 (.IBEX) registrou baixa de 1,60%, a 19.513,80 pontos. Em LISBOA, o índice PSI20 (.PSI20) desvalorizou-se 1,33%, a 9.542,21 pontos.

item.title: Auto industry urges Trump to keep Chinese automakers out ahead of Xi meeting
item.description: Major automakers, suppliers and dealers on Friday urged President Donald Trump to keep Chinese automakers out of the US market, ahead of his meeting with China's President Xi Jinping next week.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: Major automakers, suppliers and dealers on Friday urged President Donald Trump to keep Chinese automakers out of the US market, ahead of his meeting with China's President Xi Jinping next week. Last week, Trump told Fox News he would be [USN:L1N45400M TEXT:"OK with Chinese car companies"] building cars in the United States. "We urge your administration to maintain policies that keep the door firmly shut to Chinese automakers seeking to sell, import or manufacture vehicles inside the U.S.," said a letter to Trump by six groups representing General Motors (GM.N) , Toyota (7203.T) , Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) , Ford (F.N) , Hyundai (005380.KS) , Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , Tesla (TSLA.O) and others. The White House and the Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately comment. "Chinese automakers have zero market share in the U.S. Allowing them to open a domestic facility would provide a foothold in the U.S. market at the expense of manufacturers operating here," said the letter signed by the Alliance for Automotive Innovation, American Automotive Policy Council, Autos Drive America, MEMA -- The Vehicle Suppliers Association, National Automobile Dealers Association and the Zero Emission Transportation Association. The groups argue Chinese investment in the US would not create new American jobs but "shift jobs away from manufacturers that have made generational investments in the U.S. and toward companies owned and operated by the Chinese government." Michigan Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin cited a report that Xi may bring Chinese automaker BYD to Washington for the meetings, saying if that happens "we can only assume there are deals afoot to allow Chinese cars to be imported, or Chinese companies are being invited to set up shop in the U.S." A regulation imposed by former President Joe Biden's administration in early 2025 effectively banned all Chinese automakers from selling or building passenger vehicles in the US on the grounds they could send sensitive driver data to China. Washington also maintains more than 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles. Congress is currently considering legislation that would toughen the ban on Chinese vehicles. Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular connectivity and some satellite communications technologies are covered under the rules based on national security concerns linked to the ability of vehicles to collect sensitive data on American owners.

item.title: Grynspan, da Costa Rica, lidera por pequena margem votação informal para secretário-geral da ONU, dizem fontes
item.description: Uma votação informal realizada pelo Conselho de Segurança das Nações Unidas nesta sexta-feira colocou a ex-vice-presidente da Costa Rica Rebeca Grynspan à frente por uma pequena margem na disputa para se tornar a próxima secretária-geral da ONU, segundo diplomatas e outras fontes próximas ao processo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Uma votação informal realizada pelo Conselho de Segurança das Nações Unidas nesta sexta-feira colocou a ex-vice-presidente da Costa Rica Rebeca Grynspan à frente por uma pequena margem na disputa para se tornar a próxima secretária-geral da ONU, segundo diplomatas e outras fontes próximas ao processo. Foi a terceira vez que o Conselho de Segurança, composto por 15 membros, votou a portas fechadas nessa sondagem informal. A primeira votação secreta, em julho, mostrou Grynspan com uma vantagem mínima, e a segunda votação, no mês passado, colocou a embaixadora da Guiana na ONU, Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett, como a nova líder por uma pequena margem. Oito candidatos disputam a sucessão de António Guterres, que deixa o cargo no final deste ano após dois mandatos de cinco anos. Por fim, os cinco membros do Conselho com direito a veto — Estados Unidos, China, Rússia, França e Reino Unido — precisam chegar a um acordo sobre um candidato. O Conselho de Segurança da ONU recomendará formalmente um candidato à Assembleia Geral para a eleição do 10º secretário-geral da ONU. A aprovação pela Assembleia Geral, composta por 193 membros, há muito é vista como um mero formalismo. Nas votações indicativas, que devem continuar por mais algumas rodadas, os membros do Conselho de Segurança são questionados, por meio de cédulas secretas, se “apoia”, “não apoia” ou “não tem opinião” sobre os candidatos. Grynspan recebeu nove votos de apoio, cinco de rejeição e um de “sem opinião”; Birkett recebeu oito votos de apoio, seis de rejeição e um de “sem opinião”, segundo diplomatas e fontes próximas ao processo. Olara Otunnu, de Uganda, diplomata e ex-subsecretário-geral da ONU, recebeu cinco votos de apoio, sete de rejeição e três de “sem opinião”; Rafael Grossi, da Argentina, o renomado diretor-geral da agência nuclear da ONU, recebeu cinco votos de apoio, oito de rejeição e dois de “sem opinião”; enquanto o ex-presidente do Senegal, Macky Sall, recebeu cinco votos de apoio, nove de rejeição e um de “sem opinião”.

item.title: Japão realizou verificações de taxas no mercado de câmbio, informa Nikkei
item.description: As autoridades japonesas realizaram verificações de taxas no mercado cambial, segundo o jornal Nikkei, o que provocou uma forte alta do iene.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: As autoridades japonesas realizaram verificações de taxas no mercado cambial, segundo o jornal Nikkei, o que provocou uma forte alta do iene. A reportagem veio após a queda da moeda apesar da decisão do Banco do Japão nesta sexta-feira de elevar a taxa de juros para 1,25%, o maior nível em 31 anos. O Ministério das Finanças do Japão, que dirige a intervenção, não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. Uma verificação de taxas ocorre quando as autoridades solicitam aos bancos cotações cambiais para avaliar as condições do mercado, o que os operadores consideram um indício de intervenção cambial. O iene fraco tornou-se uma dor de cabeça para as autoridades japonesas, pois eleva o custo da importação de combustíveis e matérias-primas, impulsionando assim o custo de vida das famílias e a inflação em geral. Após a decisão de aumento dos juros nesta sexta-feira, o presidente do Banco do Japão, Kazuo Ueda, sinalizou que o banco central está pronto para elevar ainda mais a taxa a fim de prevenir o risco de uma inflação excessiva, embora a medida não tenha conseguido sustentar a moeda. A ministra das Finanças, Satsuki Katayama, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que as autoridades japonesas não hesitarão em realizar novas intervenções coordenadas na taxa de câmbio. O Japão e os EUA realizaram uma rara intervenção conjunta de compra do iene em 31 de julho, sinalizando sua determinação em impedir que uma liquidação do iene e dos títulos do governo japonês se espalhe para os mercados globais.

item.title: ICE agent pleads not guilty to lying about Minneapolis shooting
item.description: A US immigration agent pleaded not guilty on Friday to federal charges of lying to the FBI that he was attacked before shooting a Venezuelan man in the leg in Minneapolis at the height of President Donald Trump's deportation sweeps in January.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Allen
item.content:encoded: A US immigration agent pleaded not guilty on Friday to federal charges of lying to the FBI that he was attacked before shooting a Venezuelan man in the leg in Minneapolis at the height of President Donald Trump's deportation sweeps in January. Christian Castro, who has been suspended without pay from his job as a US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent, is the first federal law enforcement officer to be charged by the US Justice Department with wrongdoing in Operation Metro Surge, which saw thousands of armed, masked agents deployed to Minnesota's cities last winter. Federal prosecutors say that Castro lied when he told investigators that Julio Sosa-Celis, 24, and others were attacking him with a broom and snow shovel when he fired his gun. Castro's plea in the US District Court in Saint Paul comes a day after he answered to separate state charges of second-degree assault with a dangerous weapon and falsely reporting a crime brought by Hennepin County prosecutors in neighboring Minneapolis. The court appearances follow an extraordinary months-long legal battle to have Castro, who lives in Texas, returned to Minneapolis. The state charges were filed in May, but Castro, 52, spent 90 days in a county jail in Texas after Governor Greg Abbott, a Republican, refused to sign extradition papers sent down by Minnesota Governor Tim Walz, a Democrat. A few days after his release earlier this month, he was arrested again after a federal grand jury handed down an indictment of six counts of making materially false statements, which carries a maximum sentence of six years in prison. Castro drove from Texas to Minneapolis on Wednesday to surrender himself, his lawyers said, and spent the night in the Hennepin County jail before being released on bail. After the nonfatal shooting on January 14, Castro told investigators that he fired at Sosa-Celis, a Venezuelan delivery driver, when Sosa-Celis and another man attacked him in a struggle on the ground. His account was repeated by then Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and other Trump administration officials as they defended the widely protested surge in immigration enforcement in Minnesota. Prosecutors say Castro's account was disproved by video evidence, forcing the Justice Department to drop its prosecution of Sosa-Celis and open a criminal investigation into Castro. Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty said the video evidence showed Castro was standing and fired from a short distance through the front door of Sosa-Celis's home, wounding the man in the leg. "Mr. Castro invented a story to justify shooting through a front door into a house with multiple people in it," Moriarty told reporters after Thursday's state court hearing. "The bullet he fired lodged in the wall of a child's bedroom." A lawyer for Castro, Daniel Gerdts, declined to comment. Moriarty's office is continuing to investigate the federal immigration officers who fatally shot Renee Good and Alex Pretti, both US citizens, in January.

item.title: Volkswagen abaisse ses perspectives annuelles, plombées par €10 mds de charges
item.description: Volkswagen a revu vendredi nettement à la baisse ses perspectives annuelles en prenant en compte des charges exceptionnelles de 10 milliards d'euros liées à sa participation dans le constructeur Porsche , ainsi qu'à des provisions pour suppressions d'emplois et à la faiblesse du marché chinois.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) a revu vendredi nettement à la baisse ses perspectives annuelles en prenant en compte des charges exceptionnelles de 10 milliards d'euros liées à sa participation dans le constructeur Porsche (P911_p.DE) , ainsi qu'à des provisions pour suppressions d'emplois et à la faiblesse du marché chinois. A la Bourse de Francfort, l'action Volkswagen, premier constructeur automobile européen, a chuté de 8,31% à la clôture, contre une perte de 1,63% pour l'indice de référence Dax (.GDAXI) . Le secteur de l'automobile (.SXAP) sur l'indice paneuropéen Stoxx 600 a terminé en repli de 3,38%. Le groupe Volkswagen, propriétaire entre autres des marques Audi, Skoda et Seat, table désormais sur une marge bénéficiaire de 1% au mieux en 2026, alors qu'il la voyait auparavant dans une fourchette de 4,0% à 5,5%. Cet avertissement souligne l'ampleur de la crise que traverse le deuxième constructeur automobile mondial. Au début du mois, le groupe allemand a annoncé être parvenu à un accord avec les syndicats pour des économies drastiques face à la concurrence féroce des constructeurs automobiles asiatiques, à l'impact des droits de douane américains et à la stagnation de la demande en Europe. Volkswagen a ainsi mis en garde contre une "nouvelle détérioration de l'environnement du marché, notamment en Chine, et contre une accélération de l'évolution de la demande en faveur des véhicules électriques équipés de batterie". Le groupe estime que cette nouvelle donne pourrait se traduire par une baisse des perspectives concernant la demande pour les voitures de tourisme des marques Audi et Volkswagen.

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe finit en nette baisse, la prime de risque de la France s'envole
item.description: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé nette baisse vendredi, plombées par la flambée des rendements obligataires sur fond de craintes inflationnistes et budgétaires, tandis que l'écart de taux entre la France et l'Allemagne a dépassé les 100 points de base pour la première fois depuis 2012.
item.dc:creator: Diana Mandia
item.content:encoded: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé nette baisse vendredi, plombées par la flambée des rendements obligataires sur fond de craintes inflationnistes et budgétaires, tandis que l'écart de taux entre la France et l'Allemagne a dépassé les 100 points de base pour la [USN:L8N45A0TV TEXT:"première fois"] depuis 2012. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) a terminé en baisse de 1,49% à 8.065,02 points. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) a reculé de 1,63% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a abandonné 1,45%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) a perdu 1,46%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) 1,12% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) 1,12%. Sur la semaine, le CAC 40 abandonne 1,40% et le Stoxx 600 0,57%. Les actions européennes ont subi de plein fouet la forte progression des rendements obligataires, qui reflètent les anticipations des investisseurs quant à une politique monétaire plus restrictive visant à freiner l'inflation déclenchée par la guerre au Moyen-Orient. Les marchés financiers prévoient désormais entre trois et quatre nouvelles hausses des taux d'intérêt par la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) au cours des 12 prochains mois, en plus des deux déjà mises en oeuvre ces derniers mois, la dernière remontant à ce mois de septembre. Les consommateurs de la zone euro ont légèrement revu à la hausse leurs prévisions d'inflation le mois dernier, selon une enquête de la BCE publiée vendredi, et les prix à la production en Allemagne ont augmenté bien plus que prévu en août, ce qui, conjugué à des prix du pétrole qui se maintiennent au-dessus des 100 dollars le baril, laisse présager une lutte plus longue que prévu contre la hausse des prix. Les mesures de politique monétaire ont été au centre de l'attention cette semaine et ont envoyé un message de fermeté aux marchés face à une inflation persistante, notamment avec la [USN:L8N4581JU TEXT:"première hausse"] des taux d'intérêt depuis trois ans décidée par la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed) et la [USN:L8N4590WP TEXT:"mise en garde"] de la Banque d'Angleterre (BoE) concernant les mois à venir. Si la hausse des rendements est généralisée, certains pays en souffrent davantage que d'autres, dans un contexte marqué également par une surveillance renforcée de l'endettement public élevé des grandes économies mondiales. Dans la zone euro, la France, deuxième économie du bloc, s'en sort particulièrement mal. Le "spread", ou écart de rendement entre l'obligations allemandes et françaises à 10 ans a dépassé vendredi les 100 points de base (pdb), une première depuis 2012, pour s'établir autour des 104 pdb. Cet écart permet de mesurer la prime exigée par les investisseurs pour détenir la dette française par rapport à celle de Berlin, et fait l'objet d'une attention particulière alors que le processus budgétaire pour 2027 approche à grands pas. Le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu [USN:L8N4591JE TEXT:"a annoncé"] jeudi des économies de l'ordre de 54 milliards d'euros pour l'année prochaine, tout en signalant que l'objectif de ramener le déficit à 5% du PIB ne serait pas atteint cette année comme prévu, mais la prochaine. VALEURS L'opérateur français Orange (ORAN.PA) a perdu 5,8% à la suite d'un abaissement de recommandation par Morgan Stanley. Le spécialiste des soins pour animaux Virbac (VIRB.PA) a reculé de 1,2% au lendemain de la publication de ses résultats. Ailleurs en Europe, Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) , qui a revu nettement à la baisse ses prévisions peu avant la clôture, faisant notamment état de 10 milliards d'euros de charges exceptionnelles, a fini sur un recul de 8,31%. Tous les secteurs de l'indice paneuropéen Stoxx 600, à l'exception du secteur technologique (.SX8P) (+0,22%), ont clôturé dans le rouge, des banques (.SX7P) (-1,93%) à l'automobile (.SXAP) (+3,24%), en passant par les télécommunications (.SXKP) (-3,19%) et le luxe (.STXLUXP) (-2,13%). A WALL STREET Le marché obligataire pèse également sur les indices de la Bourse de New York au moment de la clôture en Europe : le Dow Jones (.DJI) perd 0,44%, le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) 0,20% et le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) 0,10%. LES INDICATEURS DU JOUR Aux Etats-Unis, la production industrielle aux États-Unis [USN:ZON00GIZP TEXT:"a stagné"] en août sur un mois, alors que les analystes tablaient sur une hausse de 0,3%, montrent les statistiques officielles publiées vendredi par la Réserve fédérale. Au Royaume-Uni, les ventes au détail [USN:ZRN00EJY9 TEXT:"ont augmenté"] en août sur un mois, de façon inattendue, selon les chiffres officiels publiés vendredi. TAUX Le rendement des bons du Trésor à dix ans progresse de 5,3 points de base pour s'établir à 5,0002%, repassant ainsi au-dessus du seuil symbolique des 5% et se rapprochant à nouveau d'un pic depuis 2007, atteint mardi dernier. Le deux ans gagne 5,1 points de base à 4,7411%. Dans la zone euro, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans a pris plus de 4 points de base pour s'établir à 3,5217%. Le deux ans a gagné 5 points de base à 3,2637%. En France, le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans s'est envolé de 12 points de base à 4,5673%, tandis que celui du titre à 30 ans a pris 9 points de base pour finir à 5,1798%. "En l'absence de catalyseurs susceptibles d'entraîner une amélioration significative des perspectives budgétaires, nous continuons de tabler sur un élargissement des spreads des OAT et devrions constater des niveaux de spreads nettement plus élevés avant de devenir constructifs", souligne Modupe Adegbembo, économiste chez Jefferies. Les CDS de la dette française à 5 ans ont pour leur part atteint 41,5 points de base, leur plus haut niveau depuis avril 2025, ce qui signifie qu'il est plus coûteux de souscrire une assurance sur la dette française que dans n'importe quelle autre économie développée. CHANGES Le dollar gagne 0,11% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , soutenu par les anticipations d'une politique plus ferme de la parte de la Fed, et s'est envolé face au yen japonais, le vote divisé concernant [USN:L8N45A0GD TEXT:"la hausse"] des taux de la Banque du Japon (BoJ) ce vendredi suscitant des doutes quant à l'ampleur du resserrement monétaire prévu. L'euro recule de 0,06% à 1,1467 dollar . PÉTROLE Les cours du pétrole se stabilisent vendredi, même si les marchés s'inquiètent d'une éventuelle aggravation du conflit au Moyen-Orient. Le Brent perd 0,1% à 104,71 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) gagne 0,48% à 102,40 dollars. L'Arabie saoudite et les Houthis, alliés de Téhéran, ont échangé jeudi de nouvelles frappes après que les rebelles yémenites ont progresse vers le détroit de Bab el-Manded et font peser de nouvelles menaces sur l'approvisionnement mondial en pétrole. item.title: Crise da Volkswagen se agrava com alerta sobre resultados
item.description: A Volkswagen reduziu drasticamente suas projeções de resultado nesta sexta-feira, ao anunciar 10 bilhões de euros em despesas não recorrentes relacionadas à sua participação na fabricante de carros esportivos de luxo Porsche , provisões para cortes de pessoal e vendas em baixa na China.
item.dc:creator: Christina Amann, Christoph Steitz
item.content:encoded: A Volkswagen reduziu drasticamente suas projeções de resultado nesta sexta-feira, ao anunciar 10 bilhões de euros em despesas não recorrentes relacionadas à sua participação na fabricante de carros esportivos de luxo Porsche (P911_p.DE) , provisões para cortes de pessoal e vendas em baixa na China. A notícia levanta dúvidas sobre a marca Porsche, que foi a mais duramente atingida pelas tarifas de importação dos Estados Unidos e pela queda vertiginosa na demanda por marcas de luxo estrangeiras na China, criando uma tempestade perfeita para a divisão que registrou uma margem de lucro de apenas 1,1% no ano passado. As ações da Volkswagen, a segunda maior montadora de veículos do mundo, fecharam com queda de 5,6% após o anúncio, enquanto as ações da Porsche caíram 3,3%. A principal acionista da Volkswagen, a Porsche SE (PSHG_p.DE) , também revisou para baixo suas perspectivas, levando suas ações a uma queda de 4,9%. Novas projeções de médio prazo para a Porsche, da qual a Volkswagen detém 75,4%, levaram a uma baixa contábil de cerca de 6 bilhões de euros, informou a empresa. O alerta sobre os lucros agrava a crise na Volkswagen, que no início deste mês conseguiu chegar a um acordo com os sindicatos sobre amplas demissões. O grupo Volkswagen, que também inclui as marcas Audi, Skoda e Seat, entre outras, agora espera uma margem de lucro de, no máximo, 1% em 2026, tendo anteriormente projetado uma margem entre 4% e 5,5%. A empresa alertou para uma “nova deterioração do ambiente de mercado, especialmente na China, bem como para uma mudança acelerada na demanda em favor de veículos elétricos a bateria”. Isso, segundo a empresa, leva a expectativas mais baixas para as marcas de automóveis de passageiros Audi e Volkswagen.

item.title: Poland's PGZ is in talks on explosives production in Canada, deputy CEO says
item.description: Polish state-owned defence group PGZ is in government-level talks on a project to begin Canadian production of trinitrotoluene, or TNT, an explosive used in bombs and artillery shells, a PGZ executive said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Karl Badohal
item.content:encoded: Polish state-owned defence group PGZ is in government-level talks on a project to begin Canadian production of trinitrotoluene, or TNT, an explosive used in bombs and artillery shells, a PGZ executive said on Friday. Following Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine , some Western countries have said they would seek to reestablish production of TNT, which was largely phased out after the Cold War due to falling demand and environmental hazards. Poland is already Europe's biggest [USN:L8N40414Q TEXT:"TNT producer"] and analysts say it is the main external supplier to the U.S. Army . The country's proximity to Russia and Ukraine has made it seek to increase production. "The Canadian (project) is currently in the discussion phase. For the time being, it does not yet have secured financing nor a specific location, but talks are underway," PGZ Deputy Chief Executive Arkadiusz Bak told Reuters. He said the government-level talks would need to be finalised "as quickly as possible", although they would take months more. After that, implementation of the project, provided the talks succeed, could take about 2 years. The Polish-Canadian discussions also include cooperation on production of nitrocellulose, used in gunpowder and other ammunition propellants. Another explosive, hexogen, could also be produced alongside TNT in Canada, Bak said. He said Canada would be the primary market for the project's TNT production, with opportunities for export as well as re-export to Poland, to secure an additional source of supply. Bak declined to specify the potential volume of TNT production in Canada, which does not yet [USN:L4N44N10R TEXT:"produce TNT"], but said it would likely be close to that of a similar project in [USN:L8N43T1IP TEXT:"Britain"] and less than Polish production. PGZ subsidiary Nitro-Chem said in March it was also aiming to double [USN:L8N40414Q TEXT:"its TNT production in Poland"] to 20,000 metric tons annually by building a new line within 3 to 4 years.

item.title: More Chinese films fill TIFF theaters as Canada-China ties warm
item.description: The Toronto International Film Festival featured more Chinese-language and China-produced films than last year, as diplomatic ties between Canada and China showed signs of improvement following a meeting between Prime Minister Mark Carney and President Xi Jinping and as Asian filmmakers try to reach new audiences.
item.dc:creator: Frances Gao, Nivedita Balu
item.content:encoded: The Toronto International Film Festival featured more Chinese-language and China-produced films than last year, as diplomatic ties between Canada and China showed signs of improvement following a meeting between Prime Minister Mark Carney and President Xi Jinping and as Asian filmmakers try to reach new audiences. A review of TIFF selections showed Mainland China and Hong Kong productions represented six titles in 2026, a rise from three at last year's festival. Many of the films were sold out. "The increase in Chinese-language films participating in international festivals may reflect a stronger desire among Chinese-language filmmakers to reach audiences beyond their home markets," director Xu Zao said in an interview. His debut animated feature, "Light Pillar," made its North American premiere. Xu said younger Chinese filmmakers, many of whom studied abroad, are increasingly seeking a global platform to reach wider audiences. “It (improving bilateral relations) may be a factor," he said. Some China-produced films at TIFF 2026 include Bai Xue's "It's My Time" starring Oscar winner Michelle Yeoh as a septuagenarian Rubik's Cube champion, the premiere of Peter Chan's "The Road Not Taken" about early-onset Alzheimer's disease and the North American premiere of Zou Jing's "A Girl Unknown," a coming-of-age drama about a girl growing up under China's one-child policy. Actor Fan Bingbing is also a recipient of TIFF's special tribute award. Yeoh, from Malaysia, agreed there had been interest in Asian films more recently. "The Koreans have done extremely well, the Japanese are amazing. Maybe it's time for the Chinese movies," she said on the red carpet. The festival also included Chinese-language films from other regions, with the number rising from previous years. Singaporean director Ang Geck Geck Priscilla's "Ah Girl" had its North American premiere, while Taiwanese-American director Feng-I Fiona Roan’s "Happily Ever After" and Malaysian-Taiwanese Mandarin drama "The Age of Goodbyes" had their world premieres. Anita Lee, chief programming officer at TIFF, said factors such as a country's regulations and cultural funding policies can influence the films that emerge. When a larger number of films come from a particular country or region, she said, it often reflects the overall strength and health of that filmmaking industry. "They're also making films about immortals, in an animated film, that could have crossover appeal," said Christopher Rea, head of the Department of Asian Studies at the University of British Columbia. "It can change people's perceptions of the country."

item.title: Edf valuta preferred equity per attrarre investitori in Edison
item.description: Edf sta valutando di utilizzare una struttura preferred equity per attirare investitori interessati all'acquisto di una quota di minoranza di Edison , dopo che le interruzioni delle forniture di Gnl legate alla guerra con l'Iran hanno compromesso le opzioni di quotazioni in borsa del gruppo italiano.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Edf sta valutando di utilizzare una struttura preferred equity per attirare investitori interessati all'acquisto di una quota di minoranza di Edison (EDNn.MI) , dopo che le interruzioni delle forniture di Gnl legate alla guerra con l'Iran hanno compromesso le opzioni di quotazioni in borsa del gruppo italiano. Lo hanno riferito tre fonti a conoscenza della situazione. Da mesi il gruppo energetico francese controllato dallo stato sta studiando una Ipo di Edison tra le opzioni disponibili per raccogliere risorse da destinare alla costruzione di nuovi reattori e al mantenimento del proprio parco nucleare in Francia. Tuttavia, Edison è legata a QatarEnergy da un contratto di lungo termine per la fornitura di gas naturale liquefatto (Gnl) e, a causa della sostanziale chiusura dello Stretto di Hormuz, le consegne risultano sospese dallo scorso aprile. La situazione ha ridotto l'attrattiva di una quotazione o di una cessione di azioni ordinarie, costringendo il colosso francese, che intende mantenere il controllo di Edison, a [USN:L6N4250ML TEXT:"rinviare il processo"], come riferito da Reuters a maggio. Secondo le fonti, Edf dovrebbe rivalutare la situazione a fine settembre e l'opzione di una struttura preferred equity sta emergendo sempre più come la soluzione preferita. Con una tale struttura gli investitori, come i grandi fondi di investimento, otterrebbero diritti economici preferenziali rispetto agli altri azionisti nella distribuzione dei flussi di cassa, sulla base di un rendimento dell'investimento prefissato. Secondo una delle fonti, questa struttura a metà strada tra capitale di rischio e debito, offrirebbe una protezione ai nuovi investitori, consentendo di avviare il processo di vendita e limitando allo stesso tempo l'impatto della volatilità legata alle interruzioni delle forniture di Gnl sulla valutazione di Edison. OPERAZIONE POSSIBILE ENTRO FINE ANNO Interpellato sull'ipotesi preferred equity, un portavoce di Edf ha richiamato le dichiarazioni rilasciate a luglio dal Cfo Claude Laruelle, secondo cui il gruppo sta proseguendo i lavori preliminari per una cessione parziale e avvierà un processo formale quando avrà maggiore visibilità sull'andamento del business. Nessun commento da parte di Edison. Secondo le fonti, se Edf decidesse di procedere e desse il via all'operazione entro fine mese, questa potrebbe chiudersi entro fine anno o all'inizio del 2027. L'anno scorso due fonti avevano indicato a Reuters una valutazione di Edison compresa tra 7 e 10 miliardi di euro. Edison ha un contratto a lungo termine con QatarEnergy per 6,4 miliardi di metri cubi di gas all'anno, pari al 10% del consumo annuo italiano. A luglio, Edison ha tagliato per la seconda volta quest'anno le proprie stime sugli utili annuali, dopo che le interruzioni nelle forniture di gas e la debolezza della produzione idroelettrica hanno inciso sui risultati del primo semestre.

item.title: Brazil police seize devices from former iFood employee in trade secrets probe
item.description: Brazilian police carried out a search-and-seizure operation this week against a former iFood employee suspected of downloading confidential commercial information before leaving the food-delivery company to join rival 99Food, according to the lead investigator.
item.dc:creator: Marcela Ayres
item.content:encoded: Brazilian police carried out a search-and-seizure operation this week against a former iFood employee suspected of downloading confidential commercial information before leaving the food-delivery company to join rival 99Food, according to the lead investigator. The case marks the latest development in a broader probe into [USN:L1N41W0YX TEXT:"alleged corporate espionage"] in Brazil's multibillion-dollar delivery industry, where competition has intensified following the entry of Chinese-backed platforms Keeta, owned by Meituan (3690.HK) , and 99Food, controlled by ride-hailing firm DiDi Global (92Sy.D) . The police operation carried out on Wednesday targeted a former strategic sales executive who had access to sensitive client information, such as sales volumes and customer profiles, while working at iFood, Angelo Lages, the police inspector leading the investigation in Rio de Janeiro, told Reuters. "The purpose of the search was to collect electronic devices so we can conduct forensic analysis and determine what happened to the data," he said late on Thursday. 99Food said it takes such reports seriously, does not tolerate the use of data obtained through illegal means, and that the individual targeted by the operation is not part of its workforce. ALLEGED THEFT OF INFORMATION iFood, owned by Dutch investment group Prosus (PRX.AS) , controls about 80% of the market, which overall processed about $20 billion in orders last year, according to industry group Abrasel. In recent months, iFood has publicly alleged attempts to obtain confidential business information through former employees and paid consultations arranged by third-party firms, charges rivals deny. iFood said this week's operation resulted from a complaint it filed involving the alleged theft of strategic and confidential commercial information by a former employee, adding that it is also pursuing legal measures to protect its data and business partners. The former employee resigned from iFood in 2025 after informing the company he would join 99Food, the inspector Lages said, adding that an internal review later identified downloads of strategic files shortly before his departure. The former employee told officers he no longer worked for 99Food and was currently operating as an independent consultant, Lages said. Investigators are also seeking to determine whether other individuals or companies gained access to the information. ANTITRUST DISPUTES The allegations of corporate espionage are unfolding alongside a series of ongoing [USN:L6N44U14D TEXT:"competition disputes"] before Brazil's antitrust regulator Cade. Keeta has accused 99Food of using exclusivity clauses and contractual provisions that allegedly make it harder for restaurants to operate across multiple platforms. Separately, iFood earlier this year asked Cade to scrutinize the expansion strategies of Keeta and 99Food, alleging they rely on heavy subsidies and sustained losses to gain market share. ($1 = 5.1326 reais)

item.title: Grynspan, de Costa Rica, lidera encuesta no oficial sobre puesto de secretario general ONU: fuentes
item.description: Una votación informal el viernes en el Consejo de Seguridad de Naciones Unidas situó a la exvicepresidenta de Costa Rica, Rebeca Grynspan, como la favorita por un estrecho margen en la carrera para convertirse en la próxima secretaria general de la ONU, informaron diplomáticos y otras fuentes cercanas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Una votación informal el viernes en el Consejo de Seguridad de Naciones Unidas situó a la exvicepresidenta de Costa Rica, Rebeca Grynspan, como la favorita por un estrecho margen en la carrera para convertirse en la próxima secretaria general de la ONU, informaron diplomáticos y otras fuentes cercanas. Era la tercera vez que los 15 miembros del Consejo de Seguridad votaban a puerta cerrada en esta encuesta informal. La primera votación secreta, celebrada en julio, situó a Grynspan ligeramente por delante, mientras que la segunda, del mes pasado, situó a la embajadora de Guyana ante la ONU, Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett, como la nueva favorita por un estrecho margen. Ocho candidatos compiten por suceder a Antonio Guterres, que dejará el cargo a finales de este año tras dos mandatos de cinco años. En última instancia, los cinco países con derecho de veto del Consejo —Estados Unidos, China, Rusia, Francia y el Reino Unido— deben ponerse de acuerdo sobre un candidato. El Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU recomendará formalmente a la Asamblea General un candidato para su elección como décimo secretario general de la ONU. La aprobación por parte de la Asamblea General, compuesta por 193 miembros, se ha considerado durante mucho tiempo un mero trámite.

item.title: Widespread sexual violence in Ukraine war, most cases tied to Russia, says UN report
item.description: Russian forces committed widespread sexual violence against civilians and prisoners of war in Ukraine, including gang rape and electric shocks to the genitals, while Ukrainian authorities were also responsible for a smaller number of violations, the UN human rights office said in a report on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Le Poidevin
item.content:encoded: Russian forces committed widespread sexual violence against civilians and prisoners of war in Ukraine, including gang rape and electric shocks to the genitals, while Ukrainian authorities were also responsible for a smaller number of violations, the UN human rights office said in a report on Friday. The report documented 1,004 verified cases of conflict-related sexual violence between February 2022, when Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine , and July 2026. Of those cases, 89% were attributed to the Russian side, including members of the armed forces, prison service and security agencies, while 11% were linked to Ukraine, including members of the Ukrainian armed forces. Russia's permanent diplomatic mission in Geneva declined to comment on the report. Ukraine's foreign ministry said in a statement it welcomed the publication of the report, which it said showed the scale of the human rights violations perpetrated by Russia and the measures being taken by Ukraine to prevent such violence and compensate victims. The statement did not comment directly on the findings of incidents of abuse by Ukrainian forces. The report cautioned that the findings were not comprehensive because conflict-related sexual violence remains significantly under-reported. It said Russia's refusal to grant the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights access to occupied Ukrainian territory, prisoners of war and civilian detainees meant the figures likely underestimate the true scale of the violations. In occupied areas of Ukraine and within Russia, Russian authorities carried out sexual violence against Ukrainian prisoners of war and detained civilians at all stages of captivity, including during capture, transfer, interrogation and detention, the report said. Violations included gang rape, rape, genital mutilation and the use of electric shocks on men's genitals with a Soviet-era field telephone known as a "tapik". The findings were based on interviews with victims of sexual violence committed by both sides. Most victims in detention were men, particularly prisoners of war and detainees, although women and children were also affected, mainly in Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine. “Sexual violence in conflict is often misunderstood to be mainly affecting women and girls, where in the Ukraine war context, the majority of survivors are men,” Danielle Bell, head of the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine, said. “And men and women require different solutions and approaches to their recovery,” she said. The report concluded that Russia had failed to take steps to prevent, investigate or prosecute sexual violence committed by its personnel and had not engaged with OHCHR's requests for information. RUSSIAN PRISONERS OF WAR In Ukrainian government-controlled territory, nearly half of the violations attributed to Ukrainian authorities against Russian and third-country prisoners of war and detainees involved threats of sexual violence and beatings to genitals. OHCHR said it did not document any cases of rape of Russian POWs by Ukrainian forces. OHCHR said Russian and third-country prisoners of war reported sexual violence in 10 official detention facilities and 55 unofficial or transit locations. The Ukrainian government had taken some steps to prevent such violations and had cooperated with OHCHR's requests, although efforts to ensure accountability remained limited, it added. “I am deeply alarmed by the prevalence of these abhorrent acts documented in our report, and fear that they are almost certainly continuing amid the unceasing violence we are witnessing every day in Ukraine,” said UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Turk.

item.title: Volkswagen recorta sus previsiones por gasto extraordinario de 11.500 millones de dólares
item.description: Volkswagen recortó drásticamente el viernes sus previsiones, señalando 10.000 millones de euros (11.500 millones de dólares) en partidas extraordinarias relacionadas con su participación en el fabricante de coches deportivos de lujo Porsche , provisiones para recortes de plantilla y la debilidad del mercado chino.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen recortó drásticamente el viernes sus previsiones, señalando 10.000 millones de euros (11.500 millones de dólares) en partidas extraordinarias relacionadas con su participación en el fabricante de coches deportivos de lujo Porsche (P911_p.DE) , provisiones para recortes de plantilla y la debilidad del mercado chino. Esta advertencia sobre las utilidades agrava la crisis de la segunda mayor automotriz del mundo, que a principios de este mes logró acordar recortes de gran alcance con los sindicatos ante la feroz competencia de sus rivales asiáticos, los aranceles estadounidenses y el estancamiento de la demanda en Europa. Las acciones de la empresa caían un 5,6% tras conocerse la noticia. El grupo con sede en Alemania, que también incluye las marcas Audi, Skoda y SEAT, entre otras, prevé ahora un margen de ganancias de como máximo un 1% en 2026, tras haber pronosticado anteriormente entre un 4,0% y un 5,5%. Volkswagen de un "mayor deterioro del entorno de mercado, especialmente en China, así como de un cambio acelerado en la demanda a favor de los vehículos eléctricos de batería". Esto, según indicó, daría lugar a unas expectativas más bajas para las marcas de sedanes Audi y Volkswagen. (1 dólar = 0,8721 euros)

item.title: EU kommt heimischen Elektrostahl-Produzenten zur Hilfe
item.description: Die EU-Kommission will die Mindestpreise für Importe von Elektrostahl deutlich anheben und damit die heimischen Unternehmen unterstützen. Es würden außerdem Importquoten eingeführt, teilte die Kommission am Freitag mit. Innerhalb dieser werde der Preis auf 2800 bis 3400 Euro pro Tonne festgelegt, für Mengen außerhalb der Quote auf 3500 Euro. Profitieren könnten davon der deutsche Stahlkonzern Thyssenkrupp Steel Europe (TKSE) und der polnische Produzent Stalprodukt. Elektrostahl wird unter anderem bei Windkraftanlagen und Stromnetzen verwendet. Die Hersteller in Europa kämpfen seit Jahren mit der Billigkonkurrenz aus Fernost, insbesondere aus China.
